project_type: Flask Python SPA web app deployed on Railway
build_system: pip + gunicorn, Railway deploys via Dockerfile or nixpacks
test_framework: No formal test framework - manual verification via build and runtime
test_command: python -c "import app; print('App module loads successfully')"
verification_instructions: 1. Run pip install -r requirements.txt 2. Run python -c to verify app module loads 3. Verify Dockerfile builds
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Gemini API key and MAKIMA_ADMIN_PASSWORD would be set as Railway env vars in production.
contribution_requirements: DO NOT touch TikTok Downloader files (downloader.js, photo.js). DO NOT change downloader logic. DO NOT do major refactoring. DO NOT hardcode Gemini API key.
key_patterns: SPA with views toggled via navigateTo() in ui.js. Body class makima-ai-body applied when on AI page. MAKIMA AI rendered by renderMakimaAI() in makima-ai.js. Backend uses _get_gemini_model() lazy init. Rate limiting per endpoint. All CSS uses dark red/black theme with CSS variables from variables.css.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), templates/index.html (main template), static/css/ (stylesheets), static/js/ (scripts), static/img/ (images). SPA navigation via ui.js with views: downloader, makima-ai, store, control, coming-soon.
